messages:
sam: quick flag question after the unified-kv pilot. we see a ~200-400ms window where reads can observe demoted prefixes during cross-node handoffs. not data loss, but breaks streaming cursor correctness SLOs.

anne: yup saw that in canary. removed a sync lease-refresh to save an RPC and opened this race. repro attached in canary logs.

miguel: can we close the window without full sync? ideas: targeted strong-read for active cursors, cheap invalidation message, or opt-in strict handoff that re-enables the lease refresh.

julia: prefer opt-in strict_handoff + telemetry. Hosted default stays async for perf; Dedicated/Private default ON. also surface metric: prefetch.handoff_inconsistent_reads.

lena: please add a chaos scenario (kill owner mid-handshake) and a unit test for epoch fencing so we don't regress.

sam: plan agreed: implement kv.unified.strict_handoff (default OFF), add metric and tracing, run 72h canary with flag ON for small % traffic + chaos tests. if perf impact small we consider wider flip later.

anne: perf microbench shows ~0.7-1ms p99 delta in handoff-heavy traces. i'll put numbers in the ticket and draft SE notes with config snippet.

opsbot: Ticket RDW-ENG-9988 created: "canary: kv strict_handoff deploy + repro". Assignees: sam, anne, miguel, lena. Canary window: 72h. Link: https://tickets.internal/9988 :white_check_mark:

sam: thanks. i'll schedule the deploy tomorrow UTC and post results here. :thumbsup:
